{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "normalized_plas",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized plasma glucose level to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents the plasma glucose feature from dominating Euclidean distance computations due to its larger raw scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(plas - 120.89) / 31.95"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_mass",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized body mass index to prevent scale dominance in Euclidean distance.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aligns the variance of BMI with other physiological measurements, improving neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(mass - 31.99) / 7.88"
    },
    {
      "name": "normalized_age",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age to align variance with other physiological measurements for KNN.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures age contributes proportionally to similarity scores without overshadowing smaller-scale features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 33.24) / 11.75"
    },
    {
      "name": "elevated_metrics_cluster",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator of co-occurring elevated glucose, BMI, and blood pressure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a distinct spatial cluster for records with multiple elevated physiological metrics, aiding local neighborhood formation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((plas > 100) & (mass > 30) & (pres > 85), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_low_value_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype with low physiological measurements.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous similarity metric to a fixed reference point, anchoring the feature space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas - 90)/31.95)**2 + ((mass - 22)/7.88)**2 + ((pres - 70)/19.34)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_high_value_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype with high physiological measurements.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a secondary spatial anchor, allowing the KNN model to triangulate positions based on multiple reference profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((plas - 160)/31.95)**2 + ((mass - 40)/7.88)**2 + ((age - 60)/11.75)**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of insulin to glucose, capturing non-linear metabolic relationships.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Exposes a physiological interaction that might be hidden in raw Euclidean space, improving distance-based similarity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "insu / np.maximum(plas, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedi_age_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between genetic pedigree function and age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 250.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Expands the feature space to account for the compounding effect of age and hereditary factors on similarity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "pedi * age"
    },
    {
      "name": "missing_value_indicator_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of zero values across physiological columns, which likely represent missing data.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups structurally similar incomplete records closer together in the distance space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas == 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(pres == 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skin == 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(insu == 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(mass == 0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_insulin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed insulin levels to compress the long tail of the distribution.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "distribution_transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents extreme insulin values from disproportionately inflating distances between otherwise similar neighbors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(insu)"
    },
    {
      "name": "physiological_stress_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of physiological stress based on the combination of glucose, blood pressure, BMI, and age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, non-linear similarity metric that captures complex physiological states better than raw distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "hereditary_factor_assessment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of hereditary factors based on the pedigree function and number of pregnancies.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain knowledge about genetic predisposition into a continuous score, refining neighborhood definitions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
